### ![Android logo](data:image/png;base64,) Android Application Overview

* Select your application by clicking its name in the "Applications" table in the Overview section below.
* (Optional) Narrow down your search results to a specific version by clicking it in the "Versions" table (after selecting your application).
* (Recommended) Use filters to help you get a more detailed picture of your application. Some panels include links that create filters based on the selected value.
* Each panel has a description that explains in detail what it shows and what options it provides, if applicable. You can see their description by hovering over their info icon (a circled "i" letter).

query.esql:
FROM traces-generic.otel*
| WHERE os.name == "Android" AND span.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS failed = COUNT(*) WHERE status.code == "Error", total = COUNT(*), `p95 duration` = PERCENTILE(duration, 95) BY `Time` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Failed span rate` = 100.0 * failed / total
| KEEP `Time`, `Failed span rate`, `p95 duration`

FROM traces-generic.otel*
| WHERE os.name == "Android" AND span.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS failed = COUNT(*) WHERE status.code == "Error", total = COUNT(*), `p95 duration` = PERCENTILE(duration, 95) BY `Time` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Failed span rate` = 100.0 * failed / total
| KEEP `Time`, `Failed span rate`, `p95 duration`

query.esql:
FROM logs-generic.otel*,traces-generic.otel*
| WHERE os.name == "Android" AND session.id IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Crash Sessions` = COUNT_DISTINCT(session.id) WHERE event_name IN ("device.crash", "app.crash"), `All Sessions` = COUNT_DISTINCT(session.id) BY `Time` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Crash rate (%)` = 100.0 * `Crash Sessions` / `All Sessions`
| KEEP `Time`, `Crash rate (%)`

FROM logs-generic.otel*,traces-generic.otel*
| WHERE os.name == "Android" AND session.id IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Crash Sessions` = COUNT_DISTINCT(session.id) WHERE event_name IN ("device.crash", "app.crash"), `All Sessions` = COUNT_DISTINCT(session.id) BY `Time` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Crash rate (%)` = 100.0 * `Crash Sessions` / `All Sessions`
| KEEP `Time`, `Crash rate (%)`
